messages:
maria: deploybot blocked the prod publish for search-service. error says: missing KMS annotation on attestation when mirroring to eu-ecr. I can still see the new tag in gcr but ecr mirror has a different manifest digest.
sam: can you paste the exact deploybot reject?
maria: `deploybot: publish_reject reason=kms-annotation-missing existing_repo=eu-ecr existing_digest=sha256:dd44... attempted_repo=gcr-repo attempted_digest=sha256:ee55... check=attestation_kms_annotation`
tom: this smells like our mirror step stripped the cloud KMS annotation on the cosign attestation. mirror job probably runs with a different signer which doesn't re-attach the kms:annotation field.
release-bot: NOTE: publish halted by policy: "require_kms_annotation_for_mirrors". Manual intervention required.
sam: what's the impact footprint? prod already flipped?
maria: prod currently serving old digest sha256:aa11... new image only made it into gcr, eu-ecr mirror failed the metadata step. Traffic still on old prod.
ops-oncall: prod healthy, RPS normal. if we need a hotfix out we must either (A) force-republish the canonical image into eu-ecr with the correct annotation, or (B) rollback the build that created the gcr image and rebuild+publish properly. Fastest for emergency is to republish to eu-ecr with annotation.
tom: republish path: we can copy the artifact and sign again with cosign preserving kms annotation. we need the private key access to the KMS signer though — ops has that in the CI service account.
sam: i'm leaning to republish to eu-ecr with annotation now then run a canary. we should also create a postmortem ticket to fix the mirror job to preserve annotations.
maria: commands i ran to inspect:
```
# show gcr manifest digest
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/project/search-service:release-2026-03-21 --format='get(image_summary.fully_qualified_digest)'
# cosign verify
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod-kms/keys/cosign-key --output=json gcr.io/project/search-service@sha256:ee55...
```
cosign output shows attestation present but missing `kms:signatureKeyId` annotation. the attestation has `buildid=2026-03-21-09` though.
tom: if the attestation exists but lacks annotation, our policy rejects it because we require the key id for mirrored images. can ops re-sign the image into eu-ecr attaching the correct annotation?
ops-oncall: i can do that. i'll re-push and sign with the KMS-backed cosign key and include the annotation. doing it in ~10m. will use ephemeral tag `republish-172523` then promote to `release` once verified.
release-bot: ACTION: created ticket #RELEASE-2029 "mirror preserves kms annotation - postmortem & mirror fix" assigned to platform-ops.
sam: also add a one-liner in release notes: "temporary republish to eu-ecr to restore signed mirror metadata; no behavior change expected." keep it short.
maria: pls run smoke canary after republish. small traffic at 5rps for 3 min should suffice.
ops-oncall: republish started. logs:
```
# copy
skopeo copy docker://gcr.io/project/search-service@sha256:ee55... docker://eu-ecr.aws/search-service:republish-172523
# cosign sign with kms
cosign sign --kms projects/prod-kms/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign-key docker://eu-ecr.aws/search-service:republish-172523 --annotation kms:signatureKeyId=projects/prod-kms/cryptoKeys/cosign-key
```
ops-oncall: republish + sign completed at 21:12 UTC. staging canary running now against `republish-172523`.
sam: running quick canary now. 3 min at 5rps.
tom: cosign verify against eu-ecr digest shows annotation present and key id attached. good.
sam: canary completed: no errors.
ops-oncall: promoting ephemeral tag to `release` (atomic retag). `aws ecr batch-get-image` and `put-image` used.
release-bot: ACTION: promoted eu-ecr:republish-172523 -> eu-ecr:release by ops-oncall.
maria: unblocking deploybot: can we trigger the publish again?
tom: deploybot should pick up now. if it still blocks, we can pin like last time but i think republish fixed the metadata mismatch.
release-bot: CHECK: re-run publish policy for search-service.
release-bot: PUBLISH: search-service:release allowed.
sam: created post-release tasks: 1) mirror job fix to preserve annotations (tom), 2) add alert when mirrored attestation missing (sam), 3) update runbook for republish flow (maria).
ops-oncall: note: i kept the ephemeral digest sha256:ee55... in the ticket for audit.
maria: closing this out, will add a note to the release notes: "eu-ecr mirror required republish to restore KMS annotation on attestation; no prod rollback; canary ok."
release-bot: TICKET: RELEASE-2029 updated with republish logs and cosign verification output.
ops-oncall: archiving logs to S3: s3://redwood-logs/releases/1725234567-republish.
sam: thanks all. leaving thread open for 24h for any regression reports.
